questions.question: What happens if you forget to increment the loop variable inside a while loop?
options: An infinite loop occurs (the program never stops)
A SyntaxError is thrown before running
questions.correct_answer: An infinite loop occurs (the program never stops)
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! If the condition never turns False, the loop runs forever.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Without an update step, the condition stays True forever (infinite loop).

questions.question: When does a while loop evaluate its condition?
options: Only once at the very end
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! The condition is tested before every pass through the loop.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Python checks the while condition at the start of each iteration.

questions.question:
What is the output of:
x = 5
while x > 2:
    print(x)
    x = x - 2
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! Step 1: prints 5, x becomes 3. Step 2: prints 3, x becomes 1. 1 > 2 is False, stops!
questions.explanation_incorrect: x prints 5 (becomes 3), prints 3 (becomes 1), then terminates since 1 > 2 is False.

questions.question: Which loop is better when you DO NOT know how many times to repeat in advance?
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! while loops are ideal for state/condition-based iteration.
questions.explanation_incorrect: while loops are best when waiting for an unknown event or threshold.
